Alex —

Appreciate the quick response and the docs. A few items for compliance and finance so we can move to PO:

1) Certificate holder / additional insured: Please re-issue the COI or provide a COI that explicitly names “Redwood Inference, Inc., 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103” as Additional Insured and Certificate Holder. The attached endorsement is helpful but we need the broker to include the endorsement reference on the COI (endorsement number or policy language).

2) Waiver of subrogation: Our standard requires either a waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood or confirmation from your broker that subcontractor-caused losses are covered. If this is not routinely provided, note it in reply and we can route to Legal for a case decision.

3) Effective dates: confirm there are no retroactive exclusions and that coverage will be active through the term of the first 12 months of the PO.

4) Billing info for PO: please confirm remit-to address and the vendor tax ID exactly as it should appear on the PO/invoice. Your W-9 shows a tax ID but the billing address is missing; Procurement needs a remit address to populate the PO.

Timeline: once insurance & billing are accepted, Procurement typically issues a standard PO within 2–3 business days for low-risk vendors. If Legal needs to review due to exceptions (e.g., missing waiver of subrogation), that can add 3–5 business days.

If you can get an updated COI from your broker with the additional insured language and certificate holder named to Redwood Inference, that will keep us on the faster track.

Thanks — looping in Marissa (Finance) and Stephanie (Risk) for quick review.

Connor O'Brien
